holdings.name: ICICI Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: For Q2 FY2027 (quarter ended September 2026), ICICI Bank reported standalone net profit of ₹14,843 crore and consolidated net profit of ₹16,333 crore.
Net profit reached ₹17,389 crore on revenue of ₹55,992 crore, up from ₹16,276 crore net profit in the prior quarter.
The bank's CASA ratio dropped by 340 bps to 36.1% as FCNR (B) deposits surged.

holdings.why_it_matters: ICICI Bank is the fund's largest single holding at 7.52% weight. Its 3-month decline of -3.87% detracted an estimated -0.291% from portfolio performance, amplifying weakness across the fund's 26.2% Financials sector exposure.

holdings.name: Zomato Ltd

what_changed.text: Revenue increased to ₹24,138 crore in the quarter ended September 2026 from ₹20,211 crore in June 2026, with net profit rising to ₹125 crore.
The company reported Q2 FY27 B2C gross order value growth of 54% YoY and adjusted revenue expansion of 76% to ₹24,621 crore.
The board approved an internal restructuring of the Going-out India business and an Adonmo-Mygate share swap valued at approximately ₹156 crore.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 4.56% weight in the fund, Zomato gained 9.83% over the past 3 months, contributing an estimated 0.448% and serving as the primary positive performance driver within the fund's 9.0% Technology allocation.

holdings.name: Apar Industries Ltd

what_changed.text: Operating profit rose to ₹758 crore with operating margins expanding to 11% in June 2026, driving quarterly net profit to ₹467 crore.
The company scheduled its board meeting and analyst conference call for October 29, 2026, to review Q2 FY27 results.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 4.19% weight, Apar Industries delivered an 11.23% 3-month return, adding an estimated 0.471% to portfolio returns and helping cushion drawdowns in large-cap holdings.

watch.text: Board consideration and approval of unaudited financial results for Q2 and H1 FY27 on October 29, 2026.

holdings.name: Bajaj Finance Ltd

what_changed.text: Net profit grew to ₹6,367 crore on revenue of ₹24,546 crore for the quarter ended September 2026, while Gross NPA rose slightly to 1.06% from 0.96% in the previous quarter.
The company flagged early signs of stress emerging in its gold loans segment.
Bajaj Finance allotted secured NCDs worth ₹2,120 crore maturing in October 2031 and approved the issuance of 4,900,737 equity shares under its ESOP scheme.

holdings.why_it_matters: Bajaj Finance is a 4.08% fund position whose -12.67% return over 3 months made it the portfolio's biggest performance drag, shaving an estimated -0.517% off total fund returns.

holdings.name: Bharat Electronics Ltd

what_changed.text: Operating profit contracted to ₹1,388 crore on sales of ₹5,547 crore in June 2026, down from ₹2,982 crore on ₹10,224 crore sales in March 2026.
The company accumulated additional orders of ₹533 crore since mid-September and another ₹1,011 crore since mid-October 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: Representing 3.46% of the portfolio, the stock fell -8.74% over 3 months, creating a -0.302% estimated drag on the fund and weighing down its 17.4% Industrials sector basket.

watch.text: Board meeting scheduled for October 30, 2026, to review and approve Q2 FY27 unaudited financial results.

holdings.name: Axis Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Revenue rose to ₹38,087 crore in the quarter ended September 2026, while net profit remained broadly flat at ₹7,666 crore compared to ₹7,670 crore in June 2026.
Quarterly net profit fell short of analyst consensus expectations.
The bank appointed Rahul Shukla as Group Head of Commercial and Bharat Banking.

seeing.text: Reported quarterly profit fell short of market expectations, contributing to stock declines post-results.

holdings.why_it_matters: Axis Bank accounts for 3.07% of the portfolio. Its -2.29% return over 3 months and -3.20% drop over 1 month compounded weakness across the fund's 26.2% Financials exposure.

holdings.name: Krishna Institute Of Medical Sciences Ltd

what_changed.text: Net profit declined to ₹37 crore in June 2026 compared to ₹85 crore in June 2025, even as sales increased to ₹1,180 crore.
The company agreed to acquire a 51% stake in Sarvottam Health Care for up to ₹80 crore.

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 3.05% fund weight, the stock dropped -14.46% over 3 months, delivering a -0.441% estimated drag that severely curtailed performance across the fund's 8.4% Healthcare weighting.

holdings.name: State Bank of India

what_changed.text: SBI reported a suspected cyberattack and dark-web exposure of 3,897 customer records, though the bank stated customer balances remain completely safe.
The bank revised its lending interest rates across EBLR and RLLR benchmarks.
Net profit for the quarter ended June 2026 rose to ₹25,121 crore on revenue of ₹136,240 crore.

holdings.why_it_matters: SBI holds a 3.04% fund weight. Its -6.05% 3-month return contributed to overall drag across the 26.2% Financials sector concentration.

holdings.name: Sansera Engineering Ltd

what_changed.text: Quarterly sales reached ₹1,021 crore in June 2026 with operating margins holding at 19%, while net profit stood at ₹87 crore.
Shareholders approved a dividend of ₹4 per share at the annual general meeting held on September 24, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: Allocated at 2.73% of the portfolio, Sansera surged 21.49% over 3 months, generating an estimated 0.587% positive contribution to the fund within Consumer Discretionary (16.3% of fund).

holdings.name: Mahindra & Mahindra Ltd

what_changed.text: Quarterly net profit grew to ₹5,998 crore in June 2026 from ₹4,377 crore in June 2025, driven by revenue expansion to ₹58,188 crore.
The company reduced its stake in NDET to 49.63% from 72.07%, leading NDET to cease being a step-down subsidiary.
M&M launched the XUV 3XO CNG at ₹9.99 lakh while management stated it could sell 2,000 to 3,000 more EVs monthly if supply constraints ease.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 2.42% fund weight, M&M's 3-month return of -9.02% offset gains within the fund's 16.3% Consumer Discretionary sector allocation.

portfolio.statement: Axis Flexi Cap Fund declined -2.18% over the past 3 months and -5.05% over the past 1 month, underperforming due to notable corrections across its top financial and healthcare holdings.
interp: Broad-based weakness in heavy financial positions like Bajaj Finance, ICICI Bank, and SBI erased the positive alpha generated by engineering and mid-cap consumer names.
High single-stock gains in Sansera Engineering, Apar Industries, and Zomato provided strong partial buffers against wider large-cap drag.
portfolio.line: Financials drag offset by mid-cap engineering and consumer tech strength.

drivers.text: Bajaj Finance slumped -12.67% over 3 months following asset quality concerns and emerging stress in gold loans, creating a -0.517% portfolio drag.
Sansera Engineering delivered a 21.49% 3-month gain on sustained margin delivery, contributing 0.587% to fund returns.
Zomato added 0.448% estimated contribution behind a 54% YoY increase in B2C GOV and 76% growth in adjusted revenue.

themes.title: Large-Cap Lending and NBFC Pressure
themes.text: Asset quality adjustments and deposit ratio compression have pulled back major lending franchises despite headline profit growth.

themes.title: Industrial and Consumer Component Outperformance
themes.text: Specialised component manufacturers and power equipment suppliers have shown robust revenue momentum and strong margin resilience.

macro.why: Lending institutions are managing deposit composition shifts as CASA shares compress and deposit costs adjust.
Automobile production volumes face periodic bottlenecking in electric vehicle components, capping immediate monthly delivery upsides.

priced_in.text: Rapid order intake expansion and defense market dominance are established expectations for Bharat Electronics, leaving it vulnerable to quarterly margin contraction.

could_change.title: Asset Quality Trajectory in Retail Credit
could_change.text: If early signs of stress identified in consumer lending segments like gold loans widen into broader delinquency upticks, financial sector drag could persist.

could_change.title: Component Supply Easing for Automakers
could_change.text: Alleviation of EV component supply bottlenecks could unlock additional monthly unit shipments for key auto manufacturers.

portfolio.risk_note: With 26.2% concentrated in Financials and top 10 holdings accounting for 38.1% of assets, the portfolio is exposed to sentiment shifts and credit cycle dynamics in private and public banks.
